text:
sara: Repro for a tricky onesample-app + SDK helper + JSON strict mode. When auth retry happens we see duplicate fncall payloads and then schema validator complains about extra keys.

sara: Error log: 
```
Error: schema validation failed: duplicate key 'callId' at /response/tools/0/output
    at validate (/usr/src/app/node_modules/schema-validate/index.js:67:15)
    at wrapToolCall (/src/helpers/wrapToolCall.js:120:18)
```

miguel: timeline? looks like token refresh triggered a re-send. if helper doesn't dedupe, model/tool can run twice.

sara: timeline shows: `2026-03-21T15:12:01Z 401`, then `15:12:02Z 200`. both requests had identical payloads.

jess: FYI v0.10.x helpers had shallow merge of retry meta into response when json_mode: 'strict' which caused validators to see `_internalRetry` fields. fixed on main but not backported.

alex: put together an SDK patch that adds an idempotency header `x-rw-id` and a small client-side dedupe cache keyed by that header. PR 2399.

sara: i tried adding the header in the app, duplicates stopped but schema still fails because helper attaches `_retryMeta` to the tool output before running validation.

miguel: simple fix: clone tool output and strip keys that start with `_` before validate when json_mode === 'strict'. will open SDK issue and a patch.

ci-bot: CI triggered for sample-app:tests -> stitch-auth-retry (job queued)

jess: also we should add an integration test in sample-app that simulates a 401 then a success and asserts exactly one tool invocation and that final response passes schema validation. I'll add TEST fixture and a tiny mock token server.

alex: can we add a dev flag to disable dedupe header locally? makes debugging easier. I'll add `REDWOOD_DEV_DEDUPE=false` behavior to helper.

miguel: opened issue SDK-487 (wrapToolCall merges retry meta into tool output). patch branch: fix/strip-retrymeta-v0.10.x. PR coming.

sara: repro steps for others: 
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood/sample-app.git
cd sample-app
yarn
# start app with sdk pointing to local patched helper
REDWOOD_SDK_LOCAL=/path/to/sdk yarn start:dev
# trigger endpoint that runs function call with simulate_401=true
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/_internal/test-auth-retry -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"json_mode":"strict","simulate_401":true}'
```

jess: TEST-155 created. will add assertion: no `_` prefixed fields in response and single tool invocation.

alex: linking PR + TEST in the sample-app CI job. will also include changelog blurb about idempotency header and dedupe semantics.

miguel: patch ready, pushing PR now. tagging @jess for review.

sara: thanks all. ping me when PR is merged and i'll verify on staging. :thumbsup:
